meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude 会先宣告进入 HYPERPLAN 模式,再召集5个不同角色的AI互相批判观点;只有没被驳倒的要点会被汇总,最后必须交给规划智能体「plan」产出可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“/hyperplan”等触发词,或提出需要高严谨度的规划并希望对抗式检查时。前提:团队模式已开启,且以主管智能体在主会话运行。

say.text: hyperplan: 对我的发布计划做对抗性评审,挑出薄弱假设。
say.note: 开始进入5个成员互相批判流程。

say.text: hpp: 检查这个迁移方案,找出边界情况和过度设计。
say.note: 能存活下来的结论才会被保留。

say.text: adversarial plan 评审架构,抓跨模块风险。
say.note: 评审完会交给 plan 智能体产出计划。

howto.what_en: Claude announces 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!', creates 5 adversarial team members who attack each other's findings, keeps only surviving insights, then hands them to the 'plan' agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers on sayings like 'hyperplan' or 'hpp', or requests for adversarial planning. Requires team-mode, lead-capable agent, and main session.

say_en.text: hyperplan: run an adversarial review of my release plan and attack weak assumptions.
hpp: review this migration plan for edge cases and over-engineering.
say_en.note: Only insights that survive the attack are kept.

say_en.text: adversarial plan: critique the architecture for cross-module risks and blind spots.
say_en.note: Findings are forwarded to the plan agent.
